name: Malda Migrator accepted an attacker-supplied Comptroller
summary: Migrator.migrateAllPositions(MigrationParams) reads the source lending protocol out of caller-supplied calldata: _collectMendiPositions calls getAssetsIn(msg.sender) on params.mendiComptroller and then trusts every returned market's balanceOfUnderlying, borrowBalanceStored and underlying, with no check that the comptroller is Mendi's or that the markets are real cTokens. The only allow-list in the contract, allowedMarkets, constrains the destination Malda mToken, not the source. An attacker therefore deployed a fake comptroller and fake cToken markets that report a borrow position against real Malda underlyings, so step 3 made the allow-listed Malda markets lend the underlying to the Migrator via borrowMigration, and step 4 approved the fake market for that amount and called repayBorrowBehalf on it, letting the fake market pull the tokens straight out of the Migrator.
notes: The 5,669-byte Migrator runtime was installed by an inner CREATE in this transaction and is byte-identical at block 19464693 and at block 19512427, the block before the exploit. The contract is not a proxy and has no upgrade or module mechanism.

Two-transaction campaign by one sender: the anchor at 19512428:1 and 0x9f12f7b982ffbd90ac5944b3ab8520f7fb5a9882a0a9acf20d63f6922950e59a at 19513198:2. Each component is the exact sum of the underlying that the eight allow-listed Malda mToken markets paid to the Migrator and that the Migrator then forwarded to the attacker EOA 0x370a8db1f020ce70e8eab2502c739844ca2c2910 in those two receipts. Scanning every ERC-20 Transfer whose sender is the Migrator over its entire life shows exactly these two transactions ever routed a market underlying to an address with no code; the other 66 are ordinary Mendi-to-Malda migrations that move funds into Malda markets. Tracking the attacker EOA and both of its exploit contracts to the present shows no further receipts of these underlyings, so nothing was extracted after 19513198 and no recovery is netted here. The attacker also holds mTokens minted against worthless tokens it deployed; those positions were never redeemed for real underlying and are not counted.

deployment.creatorAddress is the ephemeral CREATE2 proxy 0xa701f98fe45d7d3df62420e2427175a5f6038f63 that a CREATE3-style Deployer used to CREATE the Migrator, because that is the immediate creator the execution trace exposes. The transaction was sent by the Malda deployer EOA 0xb819a871d20913839c37f316dc914b0570bfc0ee.
